title: Bounded TABLECONTENT table-scope CONTENTFORMAT output

scope.operation: Write one selected type-4 table-scope CONTENTFORMAT with no margin or border override.
scope.profile: Generated AC1027 2x2 scalar grid, ASCII and binary DXF.
scope.source_basis: The writer already serialized CONTENTFORMAT records and accepted the selected format values, but its table-style admission predicate also required margins or a selected border. That rejected a valid standalone table-scope format. This receipt qualifies the generated serializer profile, not native rendering semantics or producer completeness.
limits: One table-scope type-4 CONTENTFORMAT with an empty value-format string
No table margins, borders, style dependencies or custom format text
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no native CAD rendering, DWG serialization, or broader TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP support claim.

implementation: Permit the selected table-scope format profile to pass style admission when margins are absent.
Retain the existing field-domain checks and reject unsupported unit values before writing.

evidence.physical_wire: The independent scalar walker checks the exact CONTENTFORMAT field order and values: 90, 91, 92, 93, empty 300 value-format string, 40, 140, 94, 62, 340 and 144, followed by CONTENTFORMAT_END.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh imports preserve table-scope type 4, hasData, all selected format values and the absent margin override.
evidence.failure_control: Unit type 3 is refused in both encodings; a destination sentinel, table collection and explicit invalid caller value remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring unit type 1 allows the same adapter to export successfully; fresh typed readback confirms the corrected unit.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
Other CONTENTFORMAT scopes and strings, native rendering, borders, TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP dependencies and DWG output are not claimed.
